'''Mennis Duren'''<ref name="Rogue Connections">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' - "Rogue Connections" featurette</ref> was a member of a [[Mennis Duren's species|sentient species]] and had [[Color|yellow]] skin, gray [[hair]], and orange [[eye]]s. The [[alien]] was present on the [[Ring of Kafrene]] trading outpost<ref name="Rogue One" /> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] agent [[Cassian Jeron Andor]]<ref name="Ultimate Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> passed by Duren in the outpost's busy streets while the alien stood next to<ref name="Rogue One" /> a [[Delphidian]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> at a [[Foodstuff|food]] stall. Andor then passed the alien again at the entrance to an alley where the agent was due to meet his contact [[Tivik]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

Duren was later present in [[Jedha City]] on the [[moon]] of [[Jedha]], where the alien spoke with a hooded individual near several market stalls shortly before<ref name="ROUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> the city's [[Destruction of Jedha City|destruction]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]. Duren wore blue [[Clothing|robes]] while on the Ring of Kafrene<ref name="Rogue One" /> and Jedha.<ref name="ROUVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mennis Duren was created for the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Anthology'']] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Rogue One" /> Duren was portrayed by [[Dilu Miah]], who has said the character was difficult to play due to the heavy cloak.<ref name="Instagram">{{Instagram|username=dilu.tricks|url=p/BiZSQGQFSEM|name=[[Dilu Miah]]|date=2018-05-05|quote=Creature named Mennis Duren who I played on 'Rogue One' just found this pic thanks to a friend. He wasn't easy to play was dubbed duvet man because that jacket/coat was so heavy|archiveurl=https://archive.is/YLJ5z}}</ref> Prior to the film's release, the character was revealed in its first teaser trailer,<ref name="Teaser">{{SW|url=video/rogue-one-a-star-wars-story-official-teaser-trailer|text=ROGUE ONE: A STAR WARS STORY Official Teaser Trailer}}</ref> which was released on [[April 7]], 2016.<ref name="TeaserRelease">{{SW|url=news/watch-the-rogue-one-a-star-wars-story-teaser-trailer|text=Watch the ''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer!}}</ref> The character was not named in the film's theatrical release<ref name="Rogue One" /> but was identified in the "Rogue Connections" featurette included in the picture's home release. The featurette also revealed that the character was named after [[Industrial Light & Magic]] special effects artist [[Dennis Muren]].<ref name="Rogue Connections" />
